requirements.text: Students should have the ability to colour-code their modules via a colour palette or dropdown menu.
Students should be able to use a toggle or checkbox to hide cancelled classes from their timetable.
Students should be able to create custom entries for personal study blocks by clicking on specific time slots.
Students should receive instant notifications (via push notification, email, or SMS) when a new grade is posted, ideally within five minutes of entry.
Reminders for assignment deadlines should be sent one week before the due date and again 24 hours prior.
A reminder for exam dates should be sent a few days in advance.
Students should have the ability to configure their notification preferences, including the method of receiving updates (email, SMS, or in-app) and the frequency of reminders.
The feedback system should include questions focusing on content quality, delivery, and resources.
Anonymity of responses must be ensured by aggregating feedback so that individual responses cannot be traced back to specific students.
Feedback should only be accessible to module coordinators after the grading period to maintain the integrity of the grading process.
